entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Anderson & Francis (2012), Astronomy Letters 38, 331 (XHIP), Hipparcos astrometry, VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 24608: position at J1991.25; Gaia cannot see the star. Distance: Torres et al. (2015), ApJ 807, 26, Table 4: distance 13.159 +/- 0.015 pc from the orbital parallax 75.994 +/- 0.089 mas (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/807/1/26): 13.159 +/- 0.015 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star. Proper motion: VizieR V/137D/XHIP row HIP = 24608 (same row): 75.25, -426.89 mas/yr. Radial velocity from Torres et al. (2015), ApJ 807, 26, Table 4: systemic velocity +29.9387 +/- 0.0032 km/s, on the frame of the Weber & Strassmeier (2011) velocities.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 11.98 +/- 0.57 solar radii from Torres et al. (2015), ApJ 807, 26, Table 5: primary radius 11.98 +/- 0.57 solar radii (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/807/1/26). Mass 2.5687 +/- 0.0074 solar masses from Torres et al. (2015), ApJ 807, 26, Table 4: dynamical mass of the primary 2.5687 +/- 0.0074 solar masses (https://doi.org/10.1088/0004-637X/807/1/26). Temperature 4970 +/- 50 K from Torres et al. (2015), ApJ 807, 26, Table 5: primary Teff 4970 +/- 50 K.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,970 K, because every spectrum of Capella is the blended light of both giants, and the secondary is the brighter in the Hipparcos band, (l_B/l_A)_Hp = 1.204 +/- 0.060 (Torres et al. 2015, ApJ 807, 26, Table 4), so no archive spectrum is the primary's own, through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe6cf. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: skipped; gaia-xp: skipped; pulkovo: skipped; kiehling: skipped; kharitonov: skipped; burnashev: skipped; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,970 K and log g 2.69 (u1 0.636, u2 0.142): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
